payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully

decision.question: Compared with the source image, has the jacket's front closure visibly moved toward closing in the edited image, such as the front panels coming closer together along the closure?
decision.criteria: Pass if the edited image visibly shows the front panels closer together along the closure than in the source, even if an opening remains; fail if the closure is visibly no closer together or more open than in the source; unknown if the closure or its source-to-edited change cannot be judged.
decision.binding: Assess progress only on the requested jacket closure, comparing the same closure in the source and edited images; this is not a substitute for the fully closed endpoint.
decision.endpoint: The jacket's front panels have visibly moved closer together along the closure compared with the source.
decision.necessity: The rubric distinguishes no requested change from partial progress. A separate comparison is needed because the existing full-closure check fails both when there is no progress and when there is incomplete progress. The images show an open jacket in both, but the changed pose and drape do not by themselves establish closure progress.
